title: Frozen source-KL-temperature generic-greedy fresh5k Slumbot pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The top-action-weighted source-KL treatment's small positive matched internal edge and preserved Standard10 direction may transfer to a positive generic-greedy fresh5k Slumbot point estimate.
material_change: Freeze exact treatment SHA9e156681... and run eight parallel, independent, never-retried 625-hand journaled Slumbot sessions under learned-logit legal argmax execution. Audit every raw hand, terminal counter, action contract, token-chain uniqueness, model SHA, and session independence. Admit fresh20k only if pooled point >0 and at least4/8 sessions positive.
baseline: Standard10 historical generic-greedy fresh20k -11.4275 bb/100 CI[-28.7124,5.8574]. Current treatment's 65k internal delta versus T1 is +1.3412 CI[-10.0687,12.7510], 2/3 anchors positive; this is weak admission evidence, not external proof. Single imitation teacher fresh20k -18.5025 remains negative evidence.
notes: Pilot hands are excluded from the 100k qualification target. No session may be restarted or replaced; any failure is preserved and separately analyzed.
Pilot hands are not qualification hands; Goal remains unachieved.

result.summary: The exact frozen source-KL-temperature policy completed eight independent 625-hand generic-greedy Slumbot sessions with 5,000 durable, fully audited raw hands.
result.conclusion: The transfer gate failed decisively: -142.7232 bb/100, raw 95% CI [-200.6425,-84.8039], equal-session t7 CI [-220.3165,-65.1299], 0/8 positive sessions. All model/action/terminal/session/token evidence passed. The positive matched three-anchor signal did not transfer and must not be scaled.
result.next_step: Do not run fresh20k or continue source-KL-temperature scaling. Treat the current fixed-anchor proxy as invalid for external promotion and perform an outcome-blind policy-state/contract diagnostic against Standard10 and prior less-bad external policies before choosing the next learned training objective.
